audit.notes: Explicit per-subject LOSO with persisted per-fold predictions, subject-level bootstrap CI, std across subjects reported separately from CI. Added leave-one-run-out within subject (does not establish transfer to a new session). '8/10 above 0.5' is a descriptive count, not statistical significance. Pooled cross-subject scores are retained only as a descriptive appendix.

pooled_descriptive_metrics._warning: Descriptive only. Pools correlated epochs across subjects and treats them as independent. Not the inferential result.

dataset: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery, 10 subjects, left vs right fist imagery, imagery runs R04/R08/R12

naive_random_split._warning: Leaky by construction: epochs from the same subject appear in both train and test. Included to quantify inflation.

within_subject_leave_one_run_out._limitation: Leave-one-run-out within subject. Tests transfer across recording runs of the same session; does NOT establish transfer to a new recording session.
within_subject_leave_one_run_out._note_std_vs_ci: std_across_folds is the spread of the per-fold metric. The bootstrap CI is the uncertainty around the mean, computed by resampling folds (never trials).

within_subject_shuffled._limitation: Shuffled stratified trial CV within subject. Trials from the same recording run appear in both train and test. Mildly optimistic relative to leave-one-run-out.
within_subject_shuffled._note_std_vs_ci: std_across_subjects is the spread of the per-subject metric. The bootstrap CI is the uncertainty around the mean, computed by resampling subjects (never trials).
